references.text: Pharaoh refuses to let Israel go, just as God foretold to Moses
God confirms that He will force Pharaoh with a strong hand to let the people go
Pharaoh will not listen, and God will lay His hand on Egypt with great judgments
The final plague that finally forces Pharaoh to let Israel go
Pharaoh finally grants permission for Israel to leave after the tenth plague
The Lord brought Israel out of Egypt with a strong hand
Moses reminds the people that God brought them out of Egypt with a strong hand
Confession that the Lord brought Israel out of Egypt with a strong hand
Direct fulfillment of prophecy: 3:19 warns of Pharaoh's resistance, which 10:27 confirms as a result of the Lord's action.
